rows.grounds: optative of smṛ, let one remember
compound tad + abhidhāna + pūrvaṃ, adverbial accusative

items.question: How should the guru be remembered in the head?
items.inference: The practitioner remembers guru in head with haṃsa-ga and that name preceding.
uncertainties: Exact force of haṃsagaṃ remains context-dependent.
items.plain_english: One should remember the guru in the head, with the haṃsa-ga and that name preceding.
